categories.label: Week 7 validation audit
categories.summary: Week 7 projection grading: ATS 27-24-2 (52.9%), SU 34-19 (64.2%), and totals shadow 25-23 (52.1% on 48 tracked totals). Spread and totals validation remain HOLD.

items.title: Saturday slate
items.detail: 49 Saturday matchups had a usable model baseline and were graded: 24-23-2 ATS and 31-18 straight up. Charleston Southern-Clemson, The Citadel-Texas A&M and Elon-Stanford were excluded because the model had no baseline projection.

items.title: Totals shadow
items.detail: 44 Saturday games had a saved pre-kick total and graded 21-23. Combined with the four earlier Week 7 tracked totals, the totals-shadow record is 25-23. Missing pre-kick totals remain ungraded rather than being reconstructed after the result.

items.title: Release integrity
items.detail: These are projection grades against saved comparison numbers, not a wager ledger. Week 7 had no released bets, and the existing spread/totals HOLD gates are preserved after grading.

categories.label: Injuries & availability
categories.summary: Player status, starter/depth role and whether confirmed absences are already absorbed by the model baseline.

items.title: Personnel gate split
items.detail: The audit separates true Questionable/Doubtful/Unknown status uncertainty from confirmed-out impact reconciliation. This prevents a resolved Out from being treated like a game-time decision.

items.title: UNLV–Air Force
items.detail: UNLV starting QB Jackson Arnold remains a material game-day availability item in the research layer.

items.title: Alabama–Tennessee / Auburn–Georgia
items.detail: Current audit has no material status uncertainty, but confirmed absences still require impact reconciliation before personnel can clear.

categories.label: Weather & venue
categories.summary: Wind, precipitation, temperature, altitude and venue context are reviewed before kickoff.

items.title: Weather is a gate, not decoration
items.detail: Environmental inputs can affect totals, kicking and explosive-play assumptions. Missing/uncertain weather remains a readiness blocker when material.

items.title: Venue context
items.detail: Neutral site, altitude and stadium context can be stored alongside each game and updated without changing site code.

categories.label: Line movement & market
categories.summary: Current public-reference spread/total prices are kept separate from the frozen validation snapshot.

items.title: Frozen vs. current market
items.detail: Historical validation uses the saved snapshot. The site may show a newer public reference separately so live movement does not contaminate the prospective test.

items.title: Execution verification
items.detail: Public book references are research context. A displayed line is not treated as an executable wager unless location-specific price verification clears.

categories.label: Efficiency, SOS & rankings
categories.summary: Opponent-adjusted efficiency and schedule context form the statistical backbone of the projection.

items.title: Efficiency blend
items.detail: EPA, success rate, explosiveness and havoc are combined with opponent adjustment and recency weighting.

items.title: Strength of schedule
items.detail: Opponent quality and FBS/FCS context keep raw box-score production from being treated equally across schedules.

categories.label: Tempo, pace & matchup style
categories.summary: Possessions, drive pace and run/pass style help translate efficiency into scoring expectations.

items.title: Possession environment
items.detail: Pace and drive volume influence projected scoring opportunities and are especially important for totals.

items.title: Style interaction
items.detail: Run/pass tendencies, explosiveness and defensive disruption help identify matchup-specific friction.

categories.label: Travel, rest & scheduling
categories.summary: Rest days, travel distance, time-zone changes and situational scheduling spots are tracked explicitly.

items.title: Travel & rest
items.detail: Travel miles, time-zone crossings and short/long rest are maintained as distinct inputs with validation-aware coefficients.

items.title: Spot context
items.detail: Bye weeks, rivalry games and lookahead/letdown flags are research context, not automatic betting rules.

categories.label: Coaching, transfers & depth
categories.summary: Depth-chart changes, transfer impact and coaching continuity are used to interpret whether team baselines remain representative.

items.title: Depth reconciliation
items.detail: Starter and replacement roles matter more than raw injury counts. Unknown roles remain conservative review items.

items.title: Roster change
items.detail: Transfer and coaching changes can change how quickly prior performance should be trusted, especially early in a season.

categories.label: Situational trends
categories.summary: Rivalry, bye, revenge and scheduling narratives are tracked as hypotheses, not standalone picks.

items.title: No trend-shopping
items.detail: Situational angles need prospective evidence before they can affect release status. Post-hoc patterns remain research notes.

items.title: Validation first
items.detail: A large model/market difference cannot override a HOLD validation state or incomplete game-level readiness.
